page.layout: One page of text, with a centred title block at the top; below it two parallel columns (left: Oppidani, right: Agrarij) with year headings between the entries; a catchword at the bottom right.

main_text.l: Cujus collegij caput est illustris & generosus Gubernator

page.notes: Title block is set in mixed roman, italic and spaced capitals; rendered as a single head. Year headings 1595–1599 are printed in a larger figure type. The left column of the 1597 and later entries is not headed; the "Oppidani" and "Agrarij" headings are printed only once, above the first year. The word "non sedit" at the end of the 1598 Sixtus Decama line is in italic and is partly obscured by a handwritten mark; "sedit" may read differently. The catchword "Ioachimus" is printed at the lower right and overlaps a handwritten "Z" at lower left. Several ink spots and show-through marks appear across the page and were omitted. The lower left faint printed mark near the bottom right corner is a digitiser's watermark and was omitted.
